description: surface.list with a free-text q: the match is a case-insensitive substring over the method NAME and the SUMMARY, the two fields a person actually reads. This is the door that makes a 269-method surface navigable from a search box without the browser inventing its own index — and the summaries are the daemon's own sentences, written in the table, ≤140 characters and distinct one from another, which its own test enforces.

methods.summary: Mounts a webhook delivery on this surface; the signature rides as a param because stdio has no headers.
